name: public-hygiene
description: Maintain project documentation and check public-facing text before it ships. doc-care keeps docs focused on their readers and addresses duplicate, misplaced, or stale claims. leak-check finds internal-context leaks (local paths, run IDs, infra names, private provenance, private working notes, private jargon) and sends high-stakes text to a fresh subagent reviewer with a BLOCK/PASS verdict. cold-read finds context the audience lacks (terms nobody introduced, numbers without a base, unclear referents, unattributed quotes), applies separate standards to slides and documents, and asks the author for the missing facts.
